questions.q: Where do you see God's rescue or redemption in your own life story?
questions.answer: Every story has a problem and a fix. One example: "A time I really messed up and was forgiven feels like my own small rescue story, and I see God in that."

questions.q: Why do you think people everywhere love telling and hearing stories?
questions.answer: Story comes from God, and we're made in His image, so we love stories. Our lives are part of a bigger, meaningful story He is writing.

questions.q: Which topic this year has been hardest for you to understand or accept?
questions.answer: Any honest answer is welcome. One example: "Why morality and meaning need God is still hard for me, so I'd like to go back over it or try teaching it back."
